description: This file defines data models for a defect tracking system using Pydantic BaseModel. It includes models for defects, images, corrective actions, dashboard metrics, analytics, and related API responses.

classes.name: APIMessage
classes.description: Represents a simple API message with a human-readable string.

classes.name: ImageMeta
classes.description: Metadata for an image associated with a defect, including file info and URL.

classes.name: DefectBase
classes.description: Base model for defect details, used for creation and updates.

classes.name: DefectCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a defect, extends DefectBase with initial status and optional root cause.

classes.name: DefectUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating defect fields; all fields optional.

classes.name: Defect
classes.description: Full defect model with ID, timestamps, images, and action counts.

classes.name: CorrectiveActionCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a corrective action linked to a defect.

classes.name: CorrectiveActionUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating corrective action fields.

classes.name: CorrectiveAction
classes.description: Full corrective action model with IDs, timestamps, and completion info.

classes.name: DashboardCounts
classes.description: Aggregated counts for defects and overdue actions.

classes.name: TrendPoint
classes.description: Data point for trend analysis over a date bucket.

classes.name: AnalyticsResponse
classes.description: Contains trend data and average resolution time.

classes.name: OverdueActionAlert
classes.description: Details of an overdue corrective action and its related defect.

classes.name: OverdueAlertsResponse
classes.description: Collection of all overdue actions as of a specific time.

classes.name: ImageUploadBase64Request
classes.description: Request model for uploading an image via base64 encoding.

classes.name: DefectSearchResponse
classes.description: Response model for defect search queries, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Used to specify field constraints and metadata for Pydantic models.
